thread:
Jordan Kim: Hi @Evelyn  quick question — Ive been having recurring lower-back pain and my current chair makes it worse. I cant seem to sit through long review meetings without needing to stand or step out. Im worried my mid-year check-in will be interpreted poorly.
Evelyn Ortiz: Thanks for flagging, Jordan. Sorry youre dealing with that. Do you want People Ops to start an accommodation request? We can often provide an ergonomic chair or standing desk as an interim fix.
Jordan Kim: Yes please start it. Id prefer the chair first. Also can we pause any notes in the review referencing punctuality if I step out briefly? I dont want it to impact my rating.
Marco Silva: Jordan, if it helps I can swap rooms so you get the quieter review room with space to stand. Also happy to take notes if you need to step out.
Evelyn Ortiz: People Ops can open the interactive process. For formal accommodation we typically request a clinician note, but we can provide equipment right away pending paperwork. I'll also send a manager guidance memo to clarify this is supportive, not punitive.
HR Bot: @Evelyn  Created ticket ACC-4412 to request an ergonomic chair and portable laptop stand. Facilities ETA 48hrs.
Jordan Kim: Appreciate it. Timeline sounds good. For documentation: should clinician note say "needs ergonomic support" or be more specific about diagnosis?
Evelyn Ortiz: A short note stating the functional limitation (difficulty sitting for extended periods) and recommended support is sufficient. Well draft an ADA plan once we get the note. It wont be shared beyond People Ops + your manager.
Jordan Kim: Got it. Also, can we delay the self-eval deadline by a week? Im juggling a doctor visit tomorrow.
Evelyn Ortiz: Yes, we can extend by one week. Ill update the cycle deadlines and send the manager note. Would you like us to add a line asking the manager to avoid recording brief step-outs as attendance issues?
Jordan Kim: Please add that line. Thank you.
Marco Silva: Chair reserved for Jordan starting Thursday, Ill post a note on the seating board.
Evelyn Ortiz: Sending manager memo now.
HR Bot: Manager memo sent to Marco Silva: "Please coordinate temporary seating and deadline adjustments for Jordan Kim. Treat step-outs for medical reasons as non-punitive. People Ops will follow up with accommodation paperwork."
Jordan Kim: Thank you all  I feel better having this in motion. Ill send the clinic note when I have it.
Evelyn Ortiz: Keep us posted. Well track here and escalate if anything changes.
